# Dependency reviewer

Use the locked dependency graph and the OSV comparison to separate newly introduced findings from existing ones. Review direct and production dependencies first. Confirm applicability and a compatible fixed version using upstream advisories and release notes. Propose a focused change and run the quality checks. Avoid automatic major SDK upgrades and preserve the app's native compatibility.

Check open-source tools for license, maintenance, security posture, permissions, cost, and a specific Rituel workflow. Treat repository stars as context. Leave automation settings, merging, paid features, and production deployment for owner review.
